description: Fetch one court decision from entscheidsuche.ch by its id (from search_court_decisions, e.g. 'CH_BGer_005_5A-123-2020_2020-06-15'). Returns metadata (reference, date, court, canton, title, abstract), the document link and a plain-text excerpt of the decision (up to ~20 KB).
name: get_court_decision
title: Get a Swiss court decision
